name: OS X.13
about: No longer supported: Kitbasher patches X.14 and later. This profile only recognises X.13 by its tag, so that a stock X.13 file or a build Kitbasher made on it is refused with a clear message instead of being discovered as an unprofiled base. A layout or project made on X.13 is applied to the X.14 base the user loads (docs/BASES.md).
refuse: OS X.13 is no longer supported — please install OS X.14 first, then load your X.14 file. A Kitbasher build you made on X.13 still restores its machine IDs onto X.14 (docs/BASES.md).
